description: This file defines an enumeration 'ConnectivityMdcEntryKey' that provides well-known keys related to connectivity MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, notably the 'connection-id'. It implements CharSequence to allow easy manipulation of the key string.

classes.name: ConnectivityMdcEntryKey
classes.description: Enumeration of MDC key strings related to connectivity, providing implementation of CharSequence.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the key string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string between start and end indices.
